_meta.description: An Instant cloud flow with a File-type input on its 'Manually trigger a flow' trigger — this is what makes it selectable as a menu item directly from Teams' built-in flow launcher (the Workflows/Power Automate icon in the channel message compose box), with an actual file-upload control for the PDF. The analyst never leaves the compose box: pick this flow, upload the PDF, run it. This flow validates the upload, calls the 'Appraisal Review Extractor' agent's callable extraction topic to do the field extraction, parses and validates the agent's response, copies the bank's own appraisal review template to a new workbook, writes the extracted values into that workbook's named cells (sheet 'RE Collateral'), and posts the result to a designated Teams channel.
_meta.invokedBy: Teams' built-in Power Automate/Workflows flow launcher, via a File-type input on the flow's 'Manually trigger a flow' trigger — not by Copilot Studio, a SharePoint event, or a specific existing message
connectors: Microsoft Teams (shared_teams) — Post message in a channel, for the result notification
SharePoint (shared_sharepointonline) — Copy file, Get file properties, Create sharing link

Microsoft Copilot Studio (shared_CopilotStudio or your tenant's equivalent connector id) — Run a topic, to call the agent's callable extraction topic. VERIFY THIS CONNECTOR IS NOT GROUPED WITH shared_powervirtualagents IN YOUR DLP POLICY before relying on this design.
Excel Online (Business) (shared_excelonlinebusiness) — Run script, to populate the named cells listed in _meta.cellMap
costNotes: This flow still makes no AI Builder connector call of any kind — the LLM call happens inside the agent's callable topic (an inline Prompt action, see agent/appraisal-agent-topic.yaml). This flow's own connector list is Teams + SharePoint + Copilot Studio + Excel Online.

The manual trigger only fires when an analyst explicitly launches this flow from Teams and uploads a file — there is no automatic trigger surface (no folder to watch, no channel to monitor for every message), so generative spend stays tied to deliberate requests only.
Validate_Upload (filename and approximate size) runs before Call_Extraction_Agent, so a non-PDF or oversized upload never reaches the agent.

One Copilot Studio topic invocation per valid, explicitly-launched run is the variable cost — the underlying LLM cost of reading the PDF has not changed from earlier versions of this design, only how the flow is started and where it reports back.
Cell population still uses the standard Excel Online (Business) 'Run script' (Office Scripts) action — no Premium connector, no custom Azure Function.
This version still creates one new file per review, copied from your existing template, for the same reasons as before (matches the bank's existing review-package convention).

trigger.description: 'Manually trigger a flow' (Instant cloud flow) with a File-type input. This is the trigger type Teams' built-in Power Automate/Workflows flow launcher surfaces for file upload, and does not use the shared_powervirtualagents connector. The File input's exact JSON representation is UI-configured in the designer (Add an input > File) rather than something to paste literally from this reference — see DEPLOYMENT.md, Part E.

document.description: The uploaded PDF's content, base64-encoded — configured as a 'File' input in the designer, which auto-pairs with a text field for the file name.

documentFileName.description: Auto-generated companion field the designer creates alongside a File input, holding the uploaded file's original name.

Validate_Upload.description: Filename check is exact; the size check is an approximation (base64 encoding inflates byte count by roughly 4/3, so this multiplies by 0.75 to estimate original bytes) — confirm empirically against your tenant's actual trigger output before trusting the 15 MB boundary precisely.

Call_Extraction_Agent.description: Calls the 'Appraisal Review Extractor' agent's callable extraction topic (agent/appraisal-agent-topic.yaml, trigger kind OnInvokeTopic) via the Copilot Studio connector's 'Run a topic' action — a different connector than the DLP-blocked 'When Copilot Studio calls a flow' trigger this design intentionally avoids.

Post_Success_To_Teams.description: Posts to the designated notification channel (parameters.notificationChannelId) — unlike the previous 'For a selected message' version, this trigger is not bound to any specific existing message to reply into, since the analyst launched the flow from the compose box's upload form rather than acting on a message they'd already posted.

body.body: @concat('Created ', outputs('Build_Destination_File_Name'), ' from ', triggerBody()?['documentFileName'], '. ', if(equals(body('Parse_Agent_Response')?['needsManualReview'], true), concat('Needs manual verification: ', join(coalesce(body('Parse_Agent_Response')?['missingFields'], createArray()), ', '), '. ', coalesce(body('Parse_Agent_Response')?['extractionNotes'], '')), 'All 17 fields were extracted with no flags.'), ' Open the workbook: ', body('Create_Sharing_Link')?['link'])

Post_Extraction_Failure_To_Teams.description: The agent's own topic-level parse check (parseSucceeded output) failed. No file is created in this branch.

body.body: @concat('Extraction failed for ', triggerBody()?['documentFileName'], ': the agent could not produce valid data from this document. No workbook was created. Route it to manual review, or re-run this workflow if this looks like a transient issue.')

Post_Rejection_To_Teams.description: File failed the .pdf/15 MB check. The agent was never called — no generative cost was spent on this upload.

body.body: @concat(coalesce(triggerBody()?['documentFileName'], 'The uploaded file'), ' was not processed — it must be a .pdf under 15 MB. Please fix and run this workflow again.')

Handle_Write_Failure.description: Fires if the file copy, cell population, or sharing-link step failed after a successful extraction — most commonly a misconfigured templateFilePath/destinationFolderPath parameter, the Office Script not present on the copied file, or a sheet name mismatch ('RE Collateral').

inputs.errorMessage: The extracted data could not be written to a new workbook, or the run failed before extraction completed. Check the flow's run history for the specific failed action.

environmentId.description: The Power Platform environment ID that hosts the Appraisal Review Extractor agent.

appraisalAgentId.description: The bot/agent ID of 'Appraisal Review Extractor' in Copilot Studio.

extractionTopicName.description: The name of the callable extraction topic within the agent (agent/appraisal-agent-topic.yaml).

templateSiteUrl.description: SharePoint site that hosts the bank's own appraisal review template workbook (sheet 'RE Collateral').

templateFilePath.description: Server-relative path to the template file within templateSiteUrl.

destinationSiteUrl.description: SharePoint site where completed, per-review workbooks should be saved.

destinationFolderPath.description: Server-relative destination folder path within destinationSiteUrl.

notificationChannelId.description: The Teams channel this flow posts results to. There is no triggering message to reply into with this trigger type, so this is a fixed destination — typically the credit risk team's main channel.
